mapper.sql: c.id, c.course_name, c.position_id, c.course_type, c.is_required, c.cover_url, c.intro, c.status, c.published_at, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.deleted, p.position_name, (SELECT d.dept_name FROM dept_position dp_name INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = dp_name.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '0' WHERE dp_name.position_id = c.position_id AND dp_name.status = 1 ORDER BY dp_name.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS dept_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM course_chapter cc WHERE cc.course_id = c.id AND cc.deleted = 0) AS chapter_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sr.user_id) FROM study_record sr WHERE sr.course_id = c.id) AS student_count
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM course c LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = c.position_id AND p.deleted = 0
c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0
LIMIT 1
